parties.counterparty: Manufacturers' Services Western U.S. Operations, Inc. (MSL)

plans.note: Primary clause is Base Agreement 15.3 Limitations of Liability (p0272-p0273: mutual consequential/lost profits waiver; check remaining 15.3 paragraph for an aggregate cap and carve-outs). Separately review Equipment and Program Loan Agreement Section 15 Limitation of Remedies (p1574-p1575), which caps IBM liability in MSL's favour.

MSL indemnity for IBM at 15.1 (p0259) with exclusions p0263 and procedure in 15.2 (p0266 ff.). Additional MSL indemnities in Attachment 6 Appendix A section 5 (p1359) and audit costs (p1448). Loan Agreement Section 14 (p1568) runs from IBM to MSL - confirm IBM-side indemnity stays narrow.
No non-compete binding IBM located; only a competitor-acquisition termination trigger at p0116 and AECI residuals language preserving freedom to compete (p1491).

No sole-source or requirements obligation on IBM found. Verify Scope of Work (sec-3.0-2), SOW Purchase of Products (sec-6.0-4) and PO cancellation (p0722) contain no exclusivity language before concluding absent.
Only MFN found runs in our favour: MSL engineering priced to IBM on a most favored customer basis (p1099). Beneficial to us; confirm no reciprocal MFN obliging IBM.

Non-solicit at Section 9.0 (p0189) binds IBM for [*] years as to Transferred Employees. Check duration, scope and whether a general-advertising or unsolicited-response carve-out exists; p0182-p0186 give context.

No standalone convenience-termination right in the Base Agreement; exit runs through non-renewal notice (p0104 six months; SOW p0658 twelve months), breach termination (sec-5.1) and force majeure (p0323). IBM may cancel POs for convenience (p0722 - check charges). AECI Section 8 allows either party to terminate on notice (p1497). Review 5.2/5.3 for exit cost exposure.

Auto-renewal in Base Agreement 4.0 (p0104: 12-month renewals, six months' notice) and SOW 2.0 (p0658: six-month renewals but twelve months' notice, so the notice window exceeds the renewal period - likely deviation). Confirm renewal pricing under 'same terms and conditions'.

16.9 selects New York substantive law with suit in a court sited in New York within [*] years (p0300-p0301) - accepted law and courts, no arbitration. Mirrored in AECI (p1499) and Loan Agreement Section 16 (p1587). Check the express waiver language in p0300 and the contractual limitations period.

16.2 (p0281) bars assignment by either party without prior written consent - check for an IBM affiliate/successor carve-out. 16.5 Sale or Merger (p0290) requires MSL's successor to assume the Agreement (favourable). Loan Agreement Section 16 (p1578) restricts MSL only; Attachment 6 no-sublicense at p1346.

13.1 (p0197-p0198): MSL assigns all IP in hardware/Products and inventions to IBM - strongly in our favour. Confidentiality 13.2 (note p0202: IBM shall not receive MSL confidential information). Title warranty p1075; loaned-item ownership p1530; Derivative Work limits p1281/p1304; return of IBM materials p0130.

Licences run mainly from IBM to MSL (13.3 p0208 royalty-free grant limited to performing the Agreement; loan grants p1530/p1532). Confirm any licence granted to IBM extends to IBM affiliates and contractors and is not revocable at will.

All audit rights found run in IBM's favour (7.0 process audits p0163-p0164; Attachment 6 audit rights p1309 and audits/inspections p1443; consigned inventory p0909; tooling p1107; acceptance inspection p1047). Check sec-16.14 Records and Attachment 6 for any reciprocal audit of IBM or IBM-borne audit cost.

Delinquent-shipment payment adjustments and the [*]% performance penalty operate against MSL (p0749-p0757, p0418-p0419) - in our favour. Check p0722 for any cancellation charge payable by IBM on convenience cancellation and sec-6.1/6.2 for late-payment interest against IBM.

Core product warranty at SOW 19.1 (p1059), period start p1068, FRU handling p1071, exclusions sec-19.3, turnaround sec-19.5, implied-warranty treatment p1078, epidemic failure sec-19.7. MSL reps at 14.2 (p0242), tooling warranty p1094, Attachment 6 warranties p1299. Note AS-IS disclaimers running against IBM at p0174 (asset sale) and p1567 (loaned items).

No general vendor insurance article (CGL/E&O/cyber/workers' comp with IBM as additional insured). Only asset-specific cover: replacement-value insurance for consigned Products with IBM as joint insured (p0909) and tooling insurance (p1107); NIC/freight insurance references p0649, p0863. Also check sec-8-2 Risk of Loss in the Loan Agreement.

No express take-or-pay or minimum volume found, but forecast and inventory mechanics may create de facto commitments: Product Forecast (sec-11.0-4, p0876, p0881), Supply Flexibility (sec-13.2-2), EOL Inventory (sec-13.3-2), Sale of Inventory (sec-13.4) and inventory purchase obligations on termination (sec-5.2). Pricing grace-period trigger at p0769.

Rights Upon Termination (sec-5.2, incl. p0130 return of IBM documentation and confidential media) and Prices Upon Termination (sec-5.3) are the main exit provisions; Section 12.0 Transition Services (p0194-p0195) covers inbound transition only. Attachment 6 obligations on termination (p1435) and loaned-item return (p1556). Assess whether meaningful exit assistance to a successor supplier exists.
